name: MCP Bridge (dev)
author: Asekhan + Claude
description: Developer tool. Publishes the mod API and a log buffer on window.__sandustryMcp so the local MCP server (github.com/Asekhan/Sandustry-mcp-bridge) can drive the game through the DevTools port. For mod_reload it re-reads the code of mods marked live from their local folders. Opens no port and makes no network calls. Adds no content.
